result.title: Claude Code Just Called My Phone
result.description:
Your AI agent can now call you when it needs help 🤯

Here's how I'm using it with Claude Code to edit my videos:

1. If it needs a creative decision, it calls my phone and asks.
2. If a render finishes, it just sends me a text.
3. If it doesn't need my input, it keeps working without interrupting me.

No more AI agents sitting in a terminal waiting for me to respond.

@birdHQ makes this possible by letting AI agents make phone calls, send texts, and emails. And it works with Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex.

Check out Bird at the link in my pinned comment.
